start_frame: Lens down in the long meadow grass on the meadow side of the sitting shelf: seed-heads crossing the bottom of frame, the two girls small and central under the elm canopy, the flat backwater and the far parish spire readable through the heat haze.
end_frame: The same frame held to the end: nothing has changed but the sister turning her page and the heat shimmer over the far field — the stillness is the shot.
constraint_honoured: 'Static, deep staging, no move' — locked off, with the deep stage (grass / girls / water / spire) doing the work instead of a move.
